changes: Execution strictly ordered in the stopped-steady allowlisted egress window: after the steady source controller lease has expired and before bounded one-shot container startup.
Bounded recovery queries native Source API GET /api/source-ingest/dlq and GET /api/source-ingest/frontier to discover pending scheduled ingestion failures.

Strict filter: only pending entries for connector tw-twse-tpex-official-market with canonical nested event payload and external egress denied reasons matching a failed frontier with external egress denied reasons are eligible.
Refuses eligible DLQ entry count > 20 before any mutation instead of silently capping and partially replaying.
Mutation urllib POST timeout derives from the existing bounded refresh budget/deadline (SOURCE_INGEST_BOUNDED_RUN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS), retaining short read probes and existing outer workflow cap.
Only triggered when --force is explicitly provided; unforced refresh leaves unresolved DLQ entries intact for strict failure.

Post-replay verification strictly requires each selected entry present with true native success status (replayed or duplicate_skipped), failing closed on missing, pending, replay_failed, or schema_rejected.

Negative boundaries enforced: entries from different connectors, non-egress failures, active running frontiers, missing nested event structure, non-success post-replay status, overlimit count, or timeout budget exhaustion are refused and cause fail-closed.
Preserved all existing steady container stop/restore lifecycle, exact image IDs, environment restoration, CAS lease bounds, and terminal readback gates with zero new services or background daemons.
